line: Crowley's Knight of Disks: Yodh of the Name (pdf p139); the fiery part of Earth and the span from Leo to Virgo (pdf p165).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Knights (pdf p139) and on the Knight of Disks (pdf p165).

quotes.quote: The Knights represent the powers of the letter Yodh in the Name.
The Knight of Disks represents the fiery part of Earth, and refers in particular to the phenomena of mountains, earthquakes, and gravitation

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Leo to the 20th degree of Virgo (pdf p165); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules from the 21st degree of Leo to the 20th degree of Virgo
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Knight of Disks (pdf p165).

quotes.quote: Those whom he symbolizes tend to be dull, heavy and pre‐occupied with material things.
